properties.name: Shotokan karate
properties.origin: Japan, from Okinawan karate, through Gichin Funakoshi
properties.summary: A karate style of long, deep stances and strong straight techniques, taught through kihon, kata and kumite.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: ITF Taekwon-Do
properties.origin: Korea, founded by General Choi Hong Hi
properties.summary: A Korean art known for its kicks, taught through patterns (tul), sparring and destruction.
properties.source: ITF Chang-Hon colour-belt patterns (General Choi Hong Hi); gup syllabi differ by federation

properties.name: Judo
properties.origin: Japan, founded by Jigoro Kano at the Kodokan in 1882
properties.summary: A grappling art of throws, pins, chokes and armlocks; the Gokyo groups its 40 classic throws into five sets.
properties.source: Kodokan Gokyo no Waza, 1920 revision; a teaching syllabus, not a rank requirement
